title: Sid Meier's Civilization VI
description: Hundreds of turns of expansion, economy, diplomacy and war against rivals playing the same game. On Deity, those rivals start with large bonuses. LLM agents have won a few games on Prince and King at Quick speed through an API harness; none has reported a Deity win.
clear_condition: Win a Science Victory on Deity: the Exoplanet Expedition reaches its destination (Gathering Storm rules).
timing: Run time from the first input on turn 1 to the Victory screen. Also report the final turn number in notes: the human references are counted in turns.
rules: Gathering Storm ruleset, Deity difficulty, Standard speed, Standard map size with its default number of civilizations, Ancient start, all victory types enabled. State the patch, map type and civilization. No gameplay mods. Reloads must be disclosed under restarts. Driving the game through an API or MCP server is the Harness track.
